access.anon: Can browse calendar information on public section detail pages.
access.user: Can browse the personal calendar view.
access.admin: Has no special calendar view separate from regular users.
access.agent: Can read the complete personal date-range calendar through REST, GraphQL and MCP with workspace.calendar:read. REST/GraphQL use pagination.

rules.personal-feed-http-cache: Personal calendar feed responses and revoked-credential errors use private, no-store. Authorization runs before the user-scoped server-side rendering cache and conditional ETag handling.
rules.views: Course-subscribed workspaces provide semester, month, and week views with subscribed activities overlaid. Activity-only workspaces provide day, week, and month views without requiring course subscriptions.
rules.retired-sections: Current/public collection calendars, personal calendar views, feeds, and calendar event tools exclude retired Sections. A direct single-Section detail/calendar URL remains available as a historical reference, and retirement does not delete underlying schedules, exams, homeworks, or subscription relationships.
rules.mobile-agenda-first: At mobile widths, the personal calendar presents the selected week as a vertically readable agenda with time, title, type, and available location context. Previous week, today, next week, and iCal actions remain directly accessible without page-level horizontal scrolling; desktop retains the selectable grid views.
rules.week-starts-sunday: Existing academic grids start on Sunday; activity calendars use Monday-start weeks.
rules.subscription-badges: Personal calendar course cards show the viewer's teaching-assistant or auditor subscription as a localized top-right badge in desktop grids and mobile agendas. Regular subscriptions show no badge; course titles and public calendars are unchanged.
rules.event-card-types: Calendar event cards carry course, exam, homework, todo, and individually subscribed Young activity events.
rules.feed-cache-refresh: Personal iCal feeds serve a cached export while refreshing stale content asynchronously. Serving instances periodically revalidate shared cached exports so completed background refreshes become visible. Repeated stale reads briefly coalesce refresh requests; failed enqueue attempts remain retryable, and user writes still request a rebuild independently.
rules.teaching-assistant-homework: Personal calendar views, event sources, and iCal feeds preserve actual completion records but exclude a teaching-assistant homework from pending homework events at or after its due instant; no-deadline TA homework remains pending. Feed caching uses a short freshness window so due-time changes are observed promptly.

tools.name: workspace_calendar_event_list
notes: Returns course, exam, homework, todo, and subscribed Young activity events unified by overlapping date range.
Each item has type, at, endsAt, and payload; young_event carries a public activity summary.
Date-only bounds include full Shanghai days, paired bounds or seven-day default, maximum 366 days.

tools.name: workspace_calendar_timeline_get
tools.returns: { range: { from: DateTime, to: DateTime }, total: Int, events: CalendarEvent[] }
notes: Requires workspace.calendar:read, matching workspace_calendar_event_list; workspace.overview:read is not required.

tools.name: workspace_schedule_list
notes: Omitting semesterId reads all subscribed semesters; pass a semesterId to recover one current or past term.

tools.name: workspace_exam_list
notes: Omitting semesterId reads all subscribed semesters; pass a semesterId to recover one current or past term.

fields: calendarEvents (schedules + exams + homeworks + todos + subscribed young events)
